_intentgraph_notes.mcp_servers_location: MCP server registrations live in /.mcp.json at the repo root, not here. Claude Code's settings.json schema does not include mcpServers; entries placed here are silently ignored. See ADR-0028 for the move from .claude/settings.json to .mcp.json and the reason ADR-0027's split-rejection was wrong. The .codex/ mirror is .codex/config.toml [mcp.*]; scripts/check-agent-config.ts enforces parity.
_intentgraph_notes.future_mcp_servers: When IntentGraph's own MCP server ships in Phase 3, register it in /.mcp.json as `intentgraph` with command pointing at packages/skill/dist/index.js over stdio.
_intentgraph_notes.playwright_scoping: Playwright MCP is scoped per ADR-0027: local Vite dev server (http://localhost:5173) and the packaged extension's webview only. No external URLs, credentials, or production systems without explicit per-invocation human approval. Requires `npx playwright install chromium` once per machine.
_intentgraph_notes.github_scoping: github MCP is optional in early phases, load-bearing in Phase 6. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the parent env for ${VAR} expansion to resolve.
_intentgraph_notes.agent_runner_chokepoint: ESLint enforces packages/skill/src/agent-runner as the only path to model calls. See eslint.config.mjs. PreToolUse hooks at automation/hooks/ enforce the same chokepoint earlier — at edit time — so violating diffs are never written.
_intentgraph_notes.pretool_hooks: guard-eslint-config.sh blocks edits to eslint.config.* without an ADR reference. guard-agent-runner-chokepoint.sh blocks edits outside packages/skill/src/agent-runner/ that introduce model-call imports from `ai`. Phase 1 may extend this list before merge to main.
